evidence.quote: Your failure to ensure that subjects met all protocol required eligibility criteria raises significant concerns about the safety of the study subjects enrolled at your site and raises concerns about the reliability of the data collected at your site.

evidence.quote: The investigational plan for Protocol (b)(4) required you to ensure that subjects met all eligibility criteria before enrollment in the study.
